newsitem.title: USA: Rexall-TwinLab deal seeks pooling of interests. [CORRECTED 22:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Rexall-TwinLab deal seeks pooling of interests. [CORRECTED 22:47 GMT]

text.p: TwinLab Corp and Rexall Sundown Inc have informed the Securities and Exchange Commission that any merger between the companies would be accounted for as a pooling of interests, TwinLab said Thursday.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, TwinLab confirmed it was in substantive discussions with Rexall relating to a potential merger that would combine the two makers of vitamins and nutritional supplements.
Under discussion is a plan that would involve Rexall issuing 0.74 of a share for each share of the company's common stock outstanding.
Any agreement would be subject to a number of conditions, including regulatory approval and confirmation that pooling of interests was applicable.
Rexall Chief Financial Officer Gary Cotton later confirmed that Rexall was seeking SEC pre-clearance for pooling of interests accounting regarding the potential merger.

handling.status: corrects title to clarify that the deal still requires approval
